behaviours.description: A coin (assets/prefabs/coin.prefab.json): counts itself into the [GameState] at `start`, and when the player enters its `collect` zone (a `fynkel.TriggerZone` with `once`) it scores, plays [pickup] once (M3-11: a fire-and-forget `world.audio.play` — the coin is gone a tick later, so no source on it could finish), leaves a burst of sparks (the `burst` prefab instantiated at runtime, its pieces kicked apart and despawned by their `LifetimeDespawn`) and destroys its prefab instance — the anchor entity the scene spawned it under, so nothing of the coin stays.
